sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No repair required. The candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, controlled approved/true and revoked/false status alternatives with maxCount 1, evidenceArtifact evidence with either alternative-calculation or model-test basis, and the required Ke/RCH quantity alternative with the declared datatypes and units.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the Complex-readiness shape to encode the approval and revocation semantics faithfully: constrain approvalRevocationStatus to the declared controlled evidence-state values and model the permitted approved/revoked status rather than accepting any evidenceState instance. Ensure the evidence alternative is structurally compatible with hasEvidence's evidenceArtifact range and explicitly represents either the more-precise-calculation basis or the model-test basis; the current class-only sh:or can pass an unsubstantiated typed node. Preserve the required ship target and the Ke/RCH result alternatives, and do not add the nonmandatory ship-performance-experience evidence.

Repair the status alternatives to prevent accidental passes from contradictory data: add sh:maxCount 1 to both approvalStatus and approvalRevocationStatus, while preserving the approved/true and revoked/false pairings and the controlled revocation values. Preserve the ship target, Ke/RCH alternative, and evidenceArtifact plus either alternativeCalculationEvidence or modelTestEvidence basis structure; do not add nonmandatory ship-performance-experience evidence.

Preserve the approved/revoked status alternatives, controlled evidence-state values, maxCount 1 constraints, evidenceArtifact typing, and either alternativeCalculationEvidence or modelTestEvidence evidence basis. Repair the Ke/RCH result logic: do not impose sh:minCount 1 for both engineOutputCoefficientKe and brashIceChannelResistanceRch outside the alternative; the current shape requires both and makes the following sh:or redundant. Encode the required in-lieu alternative so that an individual ship has either the Ke result or the RCH result, with the applicable quantity shape and unit.

No repair required. The candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, controlled approved/true and revoked/false status alternatives with maxCount 1, evidenceArtifact evidence with either alternative-calculation or model-test basis, and the required Ke/RCH quantity alternative with the declared datatypes and units.
